findings.sales: Trailing-twelve-month written sales are $10.21M (+8.0% vs the prior twelve months) at a 45.3% gross margin. Sofas & Sectionals is the largest category (31% of sales, 42% GM).
findings.custom: Custom Canadian-made pieces are 26% of sales at a 39.3% line margin vs 47.7% for ready-made stock, but they tie up customers' money and the store's attention for ~60 days per order.
findings.promotions: Promotions generated $650,281 of incremental gross profit against $795,082 of discounts. Best: New Year Blowout 2024 ($238,888 incremental GP); weakest: Holiday Sale 2025 (-$76,099).
findings.cross_sell: Strongest attachment: Dining chairs -> Sideboards & buffets (confidence 24%, lift 5.5x) - a candidate for bundles and room packages.
findings.reps: Gross margin by sales associate ranges from 44.7% (EMP-S09) to 45.7% (EMP-S07); the share of lines carrying a discretionary discount ranges from 4.4% (EMP-S02) to 6.2% (EMP-S05).
findings.inventory: Stocked inventory is $504,088 at cost (7.9 turns a year); 58 SKUs carry more than 180 days of cover ($132,666) and $79,770 has been on the floor more than six months. Carrying cost at 22% a year is ~$109,351. A further $277,917 is customer-allocated (custom and reserved) and already sold.
findings.stockouts: Stockouts on ready-made lines cost an estimated $488,532 of sales in the last twelve months, while slow lines sit overstocked - 133 SKUs should be reordered now under service-level reorder points.
findings.suppliers: Suppliers delivered 71% of purchase orders on time; Intercon (Specialty importer) is weakest at 46% on time with a 90th-percentile delay of 21 days.
findings.orders: 219 orders are open (137 custom) worth $1.02M incl. GST; customers have paid $495,984 in deposits and $519,490 is still to collect at pickup. 53 open orders are past their promised ready date.
findings.fulfilment: Only 54% of custom orders were ready by the promised date; 3.5% of custom orders cancel, mostly after supplier delays. Saturday pickup slots run at 92% utilisation and all 9 slots were full on 139 days.
findings.customers: Furniture is bought rarely: only 8% of first-time buyers return within 12 months (13% within 24). Value therefore comes from basket size and referrals; estimated 5-year customer value averages $2,153 of gross profit.
findings.consults: Free design consultations convert 52% of the time and the resulting orders average $7,246 vs $3,026 for other orders. Follow-up matters: 32% conversion with no follow-up vs 53% with two. Designer conversion ranges from 47% (DSN-03) to 58% (DSN-01).
